assets.name: xoltacan-panel
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a wide landscape 16:9 full bleed decorative material illustration for panels of a fantasy jungle RPG encyclopedia. An ancient carved jade and blue-green basalt slab, weathered bronze geometric inlay and warm gold seam glints, dense sculpted fern and vine relief confined to the margins, turquoise mineral veins, deep emerald and malachite layers, touches of burnt terracotta and moss green. Rich saturated colors, intricate tactile chisel and patina detail, raking side light. Central two thirds remains dark jade with subtle varied stone grain, suitable for pale readable overlaid text; ornamental detail at corners and outer edges. Flat front-facing material, no perspective, no mockup, no UI, no text, no letters, no people, no maps, no blank white or beige expanse. Beautiful painted fantasy craft.
